title: Among all customer segments, which segment has the highest total gas consum
question: Among all customer segments, which segment has the highest total gas consumption by EUR-paying customers, and what is the average price per item purchased by customers in that segment?

prediction.sql:
WITH SegmentConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
),
TopSegment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM SegmentConsumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ts.segment,
    AVG(t.XCL_018) AS avg_price_per_item
FROM TopSegment ts
INNER JOIN customers c ON ts.segment = c.XCL_002
INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'

WITH SegmentConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
),
TopSegment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM SegmentConsumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ts.segment,
    AVG(t.XCL_018) AS avg_price_per_item
FROM TopSegment ts
INNER JOIN customers c ON ts.segment = c.XCL_002
INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'

top_segment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM gas_consumption
    ORDER BY total_gas_consumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_price AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(t.XCL_018) AS avg_price_per_item
    FROM transactions_1k t
    JOIN customers c ON t.XCL_013 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = (SELECT segment FROM top_segment)
)
SELECT 
    ts.segment,
    ap.avg_price_per_item
FROM top_segment ts
CROSS JOIN avg_price ap

react.raw_react_sql:
WITH SegmentConsumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        SUM(ym.XCL_021) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.XCL_002
),
TopSegment AS (
    SELECT segment
    FROM SegmentConsumption
    ORDER BY total_consumption DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ts.segment,
    AVG(t.XCL_018) AS avg_price_per_item
FROM TopSegment ts
INNER JOIN customers c ON ts.segment = c.XCL_002
INNER JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'EUR'
